bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
thread="$(docker exec "$cid" sh -c 'printf %s "$VIDEOBOT_VIDEO_SALE_THREAD_ID"')"
test -n "$thread" || exit 61
GACE_THREAD="$thread" python3 -B - <<'PY'
import asyncio,json,os,pathlib,stat,uuid,sys
p=pathlib.Path("/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock")
if not p.is_socket() or p.stat().st_uid!=os.getuid() or stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)!=0o600:sys.exit(62)
async def f():
  r,w=await asyncio.open_unix_connection(str(p))
  try:
    k=uuid.uuid4().hex
    q={"request_id":k,"action":"video_sale_readback","chat_id":-1002373696859,
       "thread_id":int(os.environ["GACE_THREAD"]),"message_ids":[4689,4690,4691]}
    w.write((json.dumps(q)+"\n").encode());await w.drain()
    result=json.loads(await asyncio.wait_for(r.readline(),40))
    if result.get("request_id")!=k or result.get("status")!="PASS":return None
    return result
  finally:
    w.close();await w.wait_closed()
res=asyncio.run(f())
if res is None:sys.exit(74)
print("OLD_ALBUM_GROUPED="+str(res.get("free_album_grouped")))
print("OLD_NATIVE_STARS="+str(res.get("paid_media_native")))
if res.get("free_album_grouped") and res.get("paid_media_native"):sys.exit(0)
if not res.get("free_album_grouped") and res.get("paid_media_native"):sys.exit(71)
if res.get("free_album_grouped") and not res.get("paid_media_native"):sys.exit(72)
sys.exit(73)
PY
